verified.name: Blue Origin
verified.description: Private American space technology company headquartered in Kent, Washington that operates the suborbital New Shepard rocket and heavy-lift New Glenn rocket, and is developing the Blue Moon human lunar lander for NASA's Artemis program.
verified.notes: Wikipedia lists company as 'Private' not 'SPAC' as in database entry. No total_raised, valuation, or specific investor information found in sources. Current CEO is Dave Limp (as of September 2023).

changesProposed.name: Scale AI

verified.name: Scale AI
verified.description: An artificial intelligence infrastructure and software company that provides high-quality training data, RLHF services, LLM evaluation, and enterprise software suites to build and deploy AI applications.
verified.notes: In June 2025, Meta Platforms acquired a 49% non-voting stake in Scale AI for $14.8 billion. Founder Alexandr Wang left to join Meta and was replaced by Jason Droege as CEO. Company remains independent. Lucy Guo was fired in 2018 but is listed as co-founder.

changesProposed.name: SpaceX

verified.name: SpaceX
verified.description: American spaceflight, telecommunications, and artificial intelligence company that operates three divisions: Space (orbital launches), Connectivity (Starlink satellite communications), and Artificial Intelligence (Grok and data centers).
verified.notes: SpaceX completed its initial public offering on June 12, 2026, raising $86 billion, described as the largest IPO in history. Elon Musk owns 42% of outstanding shares and controls 85% of voting power via super-voting stock. As of May 2026, Falcon 9 launches averaged approximately three missions per week with nearly 650 booster landings and reflights completed. No valuation figure could be verified from sources provided; database entry claims $1.65T but this is not supported by the Wikipedia article which does not state a current valuation.
